s: I'm a graphic designer studying Visual Communication at Bezalel.

My work is influenced by international visual culture, with a focus on contemporary Asian design. I value thoughtful collaboration and clear communication, creating visual branding and UX/UI design that is intuitive, personal, and refined.
My goal is to create design that connects, communicates, and resonates, translating complex ideas into distinctive visual identities and digital experiences that feel natural to engage with.
